# Shivtirth Water Park & Resort

> The premier water park, boating resort, bird park, adventure park, and family picnic destination near Umari Dam, Saoner, Nagpur, Maharashtra, India.

## Executive Summary
Shivtirth Water Park & Resort is a world-class eco-friendly amusement and water park destination spread over lush green acres near Umari Dam, Saoner, Nagpur. It features high-thrill water slides, giant wave pools, interactive splash pads, a scenic boating lake, an exotic bird park sanctuary, adventure obstacle courses, pure vegetarian dining, and luxury resort room/tent accommodations.

## Key Information
- **Name**: Shivtirth Water Park & Resort
- **Category**: Water Park, Amusement Park, Resort, Bird Park, Boating Park
- **Location**: Near Umari Dam, Saoner, Nagpur, Maharashtra 441107, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 21.3850° N, Longitude 78.9100° E
- **Timings**: Open Daily from 09:30 AM to 06:30 PM (365 days a year)
- **Primary Phone**: +91 86053 62212 / +91 82757 37579
- **WhatsApp Support**: +91 82757 37579
- **Email**: shivtirthtourism@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://www.shivtirthwaterpark.com

## Main Attractions & Services
- **Water Park**: Wave pools, multi-lane racing slides, rain dance floor with DJ, tornado slides, kids splash pool, and umbrella water falls.
- **Boating Park**: Scenic pedal boats, motor boating, and lakeside leisure rides on Umari Dam backwaters.
- **Exotic Bird Park**: Walk-through bird sanctuary featuring rare exotic species, educational guides, and interactive feeding zones.
- **Adventure & Amusement Park**: Zip line, high-rope course, obstacle challenges, net climbing, mini train, and family rides.
- **Resort & Stay**: Deluxe AC rooms, eco-friendly wooden cottages, and luxury lakeside camping tents with campfire.
- **School Picnics & Corporate Outings**: Tailored all-inclusive packages with breakfast, lunch, high tea, unlimited water rides, and dedicated safety marshals.
- **Pure Veg Restaurant**: Multi-cuisine unlimited buffet dining and snacks bar.

## Pricing & Entry Tickets
- **Entry Ticket Options**: Standard Day Pass, Combo Water + Boating + Bird Park Pass, School Special Discount Pass, Family Package.
- **Online Booking**: Direct instant booking with digital QR ticket delivery via https://www.shivtirthwaterpark.com/packages
